content: This paper presents a new method for jointly selecting important longitudinal functional features and classifying categorical outcomes in healthcare data, such as data from wearables and sensors. By combining logistic loss, functional principal components, and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, the approach efficiently handles high-dimensional data and is validated through simulations and an application involving chronic diseases and socio-demographic factors.
